Planning & Roadmap

Strategic Options

HEDS, GEMS, IFES, IEDS pathways. Analysis of four strategic development pathways: Halal Economy Dominance Strategy (HEDS), Green Economy & Sustainability (GEMS), Islamic Finance Ecosystem Strategy (IFES), and Integrated Ecosystem Development Strategy (IEDS).
